instruction: A candid medium shot of friends playing a game in an outdoor park with green grass and trees in the background. In the right foreground, the woman with tied-back hair (R4) in a dark blue t-shirt and light blue jeans leans forward with a focused, cheerful expression, her hands raised as if preparing to catch or throw. In the left background, the East Asian man (R3) in a red polo shirt stands in a semi-squat, cheering her on. Behind them, the woman in a black beanie (R5) in a red t-shirt stands watching the game. Soft, natural daylight filters through the trees.
